verdict.rationale: User roles and permissions are a fair question for a business finance platform like Airwallex, but nothing in the evidence documents defining roles or permissions for team members, locations, or departments. Scoped API keys (Read/Write on specific APIs) control programmatic access, and card authorization controls govern card usage. Both are adjacent controls, not user-role management, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments
